Thanks again for the call this morning — great to meet the Acme AI team. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC/trial so we can lock timelines and owners. Attaching our POC mutual action plan (Redwood-POC-MAP.xlsx).

Recap (from our discussion):
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood inference for customer-facing summarization pipeline (latency 100-200ms p50, throughput ~200 reqs/s) and verify cost per 10k tokens under $X.
- Primary concerns: data isolation + audit logs (security), predictable throughput for peak hours, and integration to existing ingestion pipeline.

Options we discussed for a trial environment:
1) Hosted trial (fastest): Redwood hosted API + short-lived test keys. Great for smoke tests and basic functional validation.
2) Dedicated sandbox: Reserved GPU pool dedicated to Acme for load/throughput testing, predictable performance.
3) VPC trial (private): Customer VPC or peered network, full auditability and KMS integration — takes longer to provision but meets compliance.

Action items / asks for you: please confirm the following by EOD Mon Aug 10 so we can schedule provisioning work:
- Success criteria (one-line bullets) you want validated during the POC (latency, throughput, cost, quality metrics).
- Preferred trial path: Hosted -> Dedicated -> VPC OR skip hosted and go straight to Dedicated/VPC.
- Infra owner for your side (name + email) who will own VPC/network setup and firewall rules.
- Any procurement or legal constraints (NDAs, IP terms) that block VPC or dedicated sandbox onboarding.

Proposed Redwood plan (if you confirm):
- Week 0 (on confirmation): smoke tests on Hosted (1-2 days) to validate integration and basic prompts.
- Week 1: spin up Dedicated sandbox for throughput and cost testing (2-3 days of run).
- Week 2: begin VPC onboarding (if required) — security questionnaire and network handoff.

I'll coordinate provisioning with Priyom (technical enablement) and Connor (solutions engineering) — cc'd. Let me know if you want to adjust timelines.

Thanks,

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming Acme's preferences and owners: we do want to validate both throughput and cost, and security is a hard requirement for production. Answers below: 

Success criteria (short list):
- Latency: p50 < 200ms for 512-token truncation; p95 < 500ms (for dedicated sandbox).
- Throughput: sustained 200 reqs/s in load window with <5% error rate.
- Cost: operational cost estimate for steady-state < $Y / 10k tokens (we'll share budgetary cap offline).
- Quality: rouge-L for summarization baseline >= 0.41 vs our golden set; minimal hallucinations on named entities.

Preferred trial path: Dedicated sandbox first, but we want a quick Hosted smoke test if it helps unblock integration validation while you provision the sandbox. If the dedicated sandbox meets perf, we'll ask for VPC for security/compliance sign-off.

Infra owner: Alex Rivera <a.rivera@acme.ai> — Alex will own firewall rules, peering, and KMS discussions.

Procurement/legal: NDA in place, but we will need a standard SOW + DPA for any VPC/on-prem work. Procurement lead is Maria Gomez — cc'd.

One more question: ballpark estimate for Dedicated sandbox monthly run (2 GPUs, sustained) for 2-week POC — can you share the estimate so we can align with finance?

Best,
